title: Finishing Back Stroking
summary: Very gentle, long gliding passes finish the session and gradually reduce the intensity of contact.
goal: Bring the back massage to a gradual close and transition from active techniques to calm contact.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of finishing back stroking without text labels.
startingPosition: The person remains relaxed in a face-down position. Place the palms on the lower or middle back.
instructions: Place both palms on the back with light pressure.
Glide upward smoothly over soft tissue.
Move the hands outward toward the sides.
Return downward with almost no pressure.
Reduce pressure and pace slightly with each pass.
Finish with a brief, calm palm contact.
direction: Long smooth upward passes with a gentle return along the sides.
mistakes: Speeding up at the very end.
Using strong pressure during the finishing phase.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
